players: all supported outfield tracking columns; no possession filter

smoothing.method: centered rolling mean of x and y
smoothing.edge_treatment: require all 7 frames; exclude unsupported smoothed edges
smoothing.velocity: Euclidean consecutive-smoothed-position difference divided by observed frame interval

open_play_blocks.ball_out_to_set_piece: exclude from each BALL OUT timestamp through the next SET PIECE timestamp in the same period
open_play_blocks.set_piece: hard boundary even without a preceding BALL OUT

method_a.candidate_valley: maximal flat run whose speed is no greater than both immediate neighbors and strictly lower than at least one; use flat-run midpoint
method_a.close_valley_resolution: chronological; retain lower-speed candidate, with earlier time on exact tie
method_a.episode: consecutive retained valley midpoints within one eligible block

method_c.eligibility: complete player support and no excluded stoppage

visual_sample.primary: 16 indices evenly spaced over episodes sorted by start time, period, team, numeric player ID
edge_cases: highest absolute heading change among path>=3m
lowest peak speed among net displacement>=3m
